title: Managers: How to resend an invite code/notify a driver
body: From the Dispatch Console: 1.  In the Dispatch Console: Assets > Drivers and Dispatchers.  2.  Highlight the driver to be notified by clicking on the row.  Under “Things That You Can Do,” click “Notify Drivers.”  3.  A text notification will be automatically sent to the driver at the phone number listed in the driver profile.  From the Mobile App: 1.  Click the Dispatch Tab.  Click the Menu Bars on the top right.  2.  Click: Assets > Drivers and Dispatchers.  3.  Highlight the driver to be notified by clicking on the row.  Click the blue circle with the bell icon.  4.  A text notification will be automatically sent to the driver at the phone number listed in the driver profile.
